correctness.rationale: The tensor projection kernel is exactly the second q-ary Krawtchouk polynomial. Negative values form one contiguous integer interval. An exact signed-binomial second-difference identity reduces its absolute row sum to four binomial masses. Lyapunov CLT and fourth-moment uniform integrability prove the Gaussian regime; factorial moments and Poisson approximation prove the n/q finite profile. The k=2 Charlier zero at lambda=2-sqrt(2) yields a calculated positive first-derivative jump, with uniform factorial tails justifying termwise differentiation. The standalone script gave 1152 exact rational parameter comparisons, 20 full row enumerations, four Poisson branch and four sparse-crossover checks, plus a Gaussian numeric check; finite evidence is corroborative only.

value.rationale: The exact endpoint amplification of a canonical Hamming primitive idempotent is a natural harmonic invariant, useful independently of any further theorem. Every finite q>=3 case is evaluated from only four binomial masses, and the true varying-alphabet scaling law transitions from a universal Gaussian constant to an explicit nonconstant Poisson-Charlier profile with a sharp first cusp. That regime and phenomenon cannot be obtained by simply renaming the earlier fixed-binary formula; the calculation is an exact natural invariant rather than a random finite slice.
